attackers_goals: Gain code execution on the host and evade security controls.
description: Regsvr32 may be used to fetch arbitrary code from a remote host and execute it without dropping the payload onto the disk. Known to be used for malicious purposes.
investigative_actions: Check whether the executing process is benign and if this was a desired behavior as part of its normal execution flow.
name: Possible code downloading from a remote host by Regsvr32
